title: devexp-standup-2026-04-01
content:
Date: 2026-04-01
Attendees: Aisha (owner), Liam, Marisol, Ethan, + Jon (joined for SDK sync)
Remote: Zoom link in calendar (see weekly recurring)

Agenda:
- Quick status checks: SDKs, docs, samples, quickstarts
- Blockers and triage (CI / generator issues)
- Prioritize next sprint items & owners

Notes:
- SDKs
  - Python SDK: PR #342 (Liam) is behind remaining docstrings / typedoc fix. CI failing on typedoc step (see linked PR). Need to revert typedoc change or pin typedoc version. Liam to open a patch by EOD 2026-04-02.
  - JS SDK: v0.9.1 released yesterday. Marisol confirmed streaming and function-calling tests passed in staging. Still flaky on Windows CI (low priority).
  - SDK samples: Ethan finished the multi-turn chat sample; needs a short README and quickstart snippet. Target to merge by 2026-04-03.

- Docs
  - Quickstart rewrite (confluence:devexp/quickstarts): high-level flow updated to show hosted vs dedicated examples. Need short code snippets for Python and JS that match the new SDK API. Action: Marisol to sync with Liam on API differences and finalize snippets by 2026-04-05.
  - Docs site build: build is failing intermittently due to MkDocs plugin ordering. We should pin plugin versions in docs CI. Aisha will propose a change to docs-ci pipeline.

- Samples & Templates
  - New 'chatbot-with-memory' sample: prototype merged to staging branch. Feedback: include notes on state management and recommended KV cache settings. Ethan to add a short architecture diagram (ascii ok) + config examples.
  - Quickstarts: we want a single-file minimal quickstart (<=20 lines) for each language + an expanded tutorial. Decision: ship minimal quickstart first, then expanded tutorial in separate PRs.

Blockers / Risks:
- Generator toolchain issue: DE-128 (Linear) shows quickstart generator produces invalid imports when using the new import style. This blocks automated sample generation and some CI runs. RISK: delays planned quickstart landing.
- Typedoc break in Python pipeline blocking release. Workaround: re-run CI with typedoc pinned or skip typedoc in CI until fix.

Decisions made:
- Ship minimal quickstarts (single-file) by EOD 2026-04-08 even if docs site build still flaky. Docs site fix to be rolled separately.
- For Python SDK release, if typedoc fix not in by 2026-04-02, roll back typedoc change and release v1.2.0 without typedoc step; follow-up to re-enable typedoc after fix.

Action items (owner - due):
- Liam - patch typedoc CI failure; open hotfix PR (2026-04-02)
- Marisol - finalize quickstart code snippets + sync with Liam (2026-04-05)
- Ethan - add README + arch notes to chatbot-with-memory sample; merge PR (2026-04-03)
- Aisha - propose docs CI pinning change + file an infra ticket (2026-04-04)
- All - review minimal quickstarts draft in the review queue; leave feedback by 2026-04-06

Parking lot / open questions:
- Do we want to include a condensed API changelog in each quickstart for easier troubleshooting? (ask support)
- How to surface best-practice batching/kv-cache settings in samples without making examples too long? Suggest short link to Optimize docs.

Misc notes / quick reminders:
- Follow-up meeting: Quickstart release sync on 2026-04-03 10:00 PT (15 min)
- Customer ask: Sales flagged a customer wanting an on-prem quickstart example for Private deployment (KMS + no internet). We should create a short checklist. Action: Marisol to draft list (2026-04-07).

Last bits (notes to self):
- Keep samples small; prefer one explicit example that 'just works' with env vars and minimal setup.
- Avoid advanced options in minimal quickstart; put them in 'advanced' section of tutorial.

Next standup: 2026-04-08 (same time)

Attachments / links (in doc): PR #342, DE-128, quickstarts confluence page, staging sample branch.
